marketing.heroDescription: Tamer Studio is an AI-first production operating system. Plan, generate, organize, review, and publish content without switching between tools.
marketing.featuresDescription: Everything you need to manage the complete content production lifecycle.
marketing.featureWorkspacesDesc: Organize teams, members, and permissions across multiple workspaces.
marketing.featureProjectsDesc: Manage production projects with folders, tags, assets, and archiving.
marketing.featureMediaDesc: Generate and organize images, video, audio, and documents in one library.
marketing.featureProductionDesc: Run production pipelines with queues, retries, logs, and progress tracking.
marketing.featureAIDesc: Connect providers, manage models, and compose prompts with a unified playground.
marketing.featurePublishingDesc: Schedule and publish content to external platforms from a single hub.
marketing.featureBillingDesc: Manage invoices, subscriptions, and payment methods in one place.
marketing.featureAnalyticsDesc: Track production metrics, AI usage, and team performance.
marketing.featureMarketplaceDesc: Discover and integrate community-built templates and plugins.
marketing.ctaDescription: Join thousands of creators and teams who have already made the switch to AI-native production.
marketing.footerTagline: Tamer Studio. From intent to production.
marketing.aboutContent1: Tamer Studio is an AI-first production operating system built for creators who want to move from intent to production without switching between tools.
marketing.aboutContent2: We believe content production should be reproducible, auditable, and human-led. Every workflow is centered around production, not isolated AI tools.
marketing.contactDescription: Have questions about Tamer Studio? Reach out and our team will get back to you.
marketing.contactSupportHours: Available Monday to Friday, 9am to 6pm ICT.
marketing.docsDescription: Learn how to use Tamer Studio to manage your content production lifecycle.
marketing.docsGettingStartedDesc: Set up your workspace and connect your first AI provider.
marketing.docsProjectsDesc: Organize production projects with folders, tags, and assets.
marketing.docsAIDesc: Connect providers, manage models, and compose prompts.
marketing.pricingDescription: Subscribe for platform access. Consume AI with Credits. Top up anytime.
marketing.billingNote: Subscription unlocks features. Credits power AI generation.
marketing.creditPackDescription: Need more AI power? Buy Credit Packs anytime.
marketing.creditCalculatorDescription: Estimate your monthly credit usage and find the right plan.
marketing.creditUsageDescription: Estimated credit cost per AI action. Actual costs may vary by model and parameters.
marketing.faqCreditsAnswer: Credits are consumed when you run AI jobs. Each model and action has a different credit cost. Subscription plans include a monthly credit allowance. You can purchase additional Credit Packs anytime.
marketing.faqUnusedCreditsAnswer: Unused Credits do not roll over to the next billing cycle. Monitor your usage in the Billing dashboard and top up before you run out.
marketing.faqCreditPackQuestion: Can I buy a Credit Pack without a subscription?
marketing.faqCreditPackAnswer: No. Credit Packs require an active paid subscription. They are designed to supplement your monthly allowance, not replace a subscription.
marketing.faqChangePlanQuestion: Can I change my plan anytime?
marketing.faqChangePlanAnswer: Yes. You can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time. Prorated credits are applied automatically.
marketing.socialProofTitle: Trusted by creators, agencies, and businesses worldwide
marketing.aiPlatformTitle: The AI Platform for Production Teams
marketing.aiPlatformDescription: Connect any AI provider, compose prompts, automate workflows, and optimize costs — all from one unified interface.
marketing.aiMultiProviderDesc: Connect OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, OpenRouter, Kilo, and more with a single API key.
marketing.aiPromptLibraryDesc: Store, version, and reuse prompts across projects and teams.
marketing.aiWorkflowAutomationDesc: Build production pipelines that chain AI models, apply guardrails, and route outputs.
marketing.aiModelSelectionDesc: Pick the right model for each task. Compare cost, latency, and quality.
marketing.aiCostOptimizationDesc: Track spend per project, set budgets, and get alerts before you exceed limits.
marketing.aiHistoryDesc: Every AI call is logged. Review, replay, and audit every generation.
marketing.aiVersioningDesc: Version your prompts and models. Roll back to any previous state.
marketing.screenshotsDescription: From dashboard to delivery, every screen is designed for production teams.
marketing.statsSectionDescription: Real-time metrics from our production infrastructure.
marketing.testimonialsDescription: See how teams use Tamer Studio to move from intent to production.
marketing.faqDescription: Everything you need to know about Tamer Studio.
marketing.faqBillingAnswer: Tamer Studio uses a credit-based billing system. You purchase credits and consume them when running AI jobs, generating media, or using production features.
marketing.faqAIModelsAnswer: We support OpenAI (GPT-4, GPT-4o), Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude, OpenRouter, Kilo, and more. New providers are added regularly.
marketing.faqPrivacyAnswer: Your data is encrypted at rest and in transit. We do not use your data to train models. SOC 2 Type II compliant.
marketing.faqSecurityAnswer: Yes. We use industry-standard encryption, role-based access control, audit logging, and regular security assessments.
marketing.ctaNote: No credit card required. Free plan available.
marketing.blogDescription: Latest news, updates, and insights from the Tamer Studio team.
marketing.roadmapDescription: See what we are building next and share your feedback.
marketing.careersDescription: Join our team and help build the future of AI-native production.
marketing.supportDescription: Get help with Tamer Studio from our team and community.
marketing.faqSubscriptionsAnswer: Yes. You can cancel your subscription at any time. Your access continues until the end of your current billing period. No refunds are issued for the remainder of the billing cycle.
marketing.faqSubscriptionsQuestion: Can I cancel my subscription at any time?
